vibe: Warm, Trustworthy, Accessible, Professional, Ivorian Localized

headings.usage: H1-H4 headings, friendly, approachable, child-safe vibe.

body.usage: Highly legible for registration forms, dashboards, and detailed profile text.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use large padding (p-6, p-8) for breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_page: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Aggressive asymmetry to feel dynamic.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. Tighter gaps (gap-4 to gap-6) for data correlation (nanny profiles, history).
layout_and_spacing.containers: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

cards.default: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow.
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-lg), border color darkens.

buttons.style: Large hit areas for mobile usability, rounded-2xl or rounded-full. Soft shadows.

forms.style: Clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D96C4A]). Labels left-aligned. Use Shadcn customized.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism for landing page sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Solid white for dashboard.

media.description: Abstract flowing waves of green and orange colors for soft landing page background or section breaks.
Happy African family of three, perfect for parent targeting sections and trust building.
Black woman and baby playing on a blanket, ideal for nanny profiles or matching sections.
Black woman playing with child outdoors, use for active lifestyle/childcare representation.
People walking during daytime in Abidjan, grounds the app locally for Ivory Coast users.

technical_instructions.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='nanny-profile-card').
technical_instructions.accessibility: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have higher contrast.
technical_instructions.file_extensions: Use .js files (not .tsx) as specified in the rules.
technical_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react (default). For dense UI, prefer phosphor-icons if installed.
technical_instructions.components_library: Shadcn UI must be customized. Strip default Vercel-look borders and apply custom border radii and colors. Do not build Datepicker or Dialog from scratch.
